title: Phase 2 research output frontmatter
description: Structural contract for research output files in `_context/planning/research/` — domain-research, market-research, constraint research, and personas outputs.

name.description: Skill name that produced this output (e.g., `domain-research`, `market-research`, `constraint-research`, `personas`).

status.description: `draft` while the skill is mid-run; `complete` on clean exit; `archived` when superseded by a newer run.

topic.description: The specific topic or domain this research covers.

research_mode.description: How source material was gathered: from pre-loaded graph content, fresh web search, or both.

graph_hits.description: Graph node IDs or source paths matched during graph-first pre-step. Empty array if no graph hits.

legacy_scanned.description: True when `_input/legacy/` was scanned for prior-attempt domain signals (brownfield only).

conflicting_references.description: `_input/` paths that partially conflict with research findings but were not fully superseded (one section outdated, not the whole document).
